tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Professional Dance Works Overview

questions.question: Q: Name the three AQA set professional works and their choreographers.
questions.correctAnswer: 'Within Her Eyes' by James Cousins, 'Artificial Things' by Lucy Bennett and 'Emancipation of Expressionism' by Kenrick H2O Sandy.

questions.question: Q: Which professional work was created for an integrated dance company?
questions.correctAnswer: 'Artificial Things' by Lucy Bennett, created for Stopgap Dance Company which features both disabled and non-disabled dancers.

questions.question: Q: In which section of the written exam are professional works assessed?
questions.correctAnswer: Section C of the AQA 8236 written exam, worth 25 marks.

tests.name: Exam-Style Practice
tests.description: Short-answer practice on Professional Dance Works Overview

questions.question: Q: What must you know about each set professional work for the exam?
questions.correctAnswer: The choreographer, company, intention, stimulus, movement content, structure and design elements including costume, lighting, set and aural setting.

questions.question: Q: Why is it helpful to compare the set professional works?
questions.correctAnswer: Comparing works highlights similarities and differences in choreographic approach, intention, style and features, deepening understanding of each.
